criteria.statement: Only rows older than the selected cutoff and not pending publication may be claimed, in a bounded deterministic batch.
Export writes a mode-0600 gzip NDJSON artifact atomically and records its SHA-256 digest and byte size.
Pruning is impossible until a non-file protected object URI, immutable version, and matching digest are recorded.
Pruning deletes only exact protected batch members in bounded transactions and is retry-safe after crashes.
Restore validates the digest and idempotently restores every archived event without retaining archive ownership.
Large access indexes are built concurrently outside startup migrations.
Metrics expose hot bytes/rows/age, archive states, and outbox depth without scanning the full relation on every scrape.
Production rollout proves backup, canary export/protection/prune/restore, bounded startup, relay failure recovery, and rollback without manual SQL.
